description: One defect per file. Each invalid fixture isolates a single artifact-grammar violation so parser tests (P1-03 oracles, P1-04 spec-delta) can assert exactly one failure. All artifact-grammar violations fail closed with exit code 3 (charter invariant #3; design phase-0-1.md §3). `line` is 1-based; `locator` is the exact offending line (drift guard).

errors.violation: Oracle heading id fails ^## (ORC-[a-z0-9-]+-\d{3}): — the sequence must be exactly three digits.
errors.heading: ## ORC-greeting-1: Oracle sequence is not three digits
errors.locator: ## ORC-greeting-1: Oracle sequence is not three digits

errors.violation: Oracle has zero crucible-binding fences before the next `## ` heading; exactly one is required.
errors.heading: ## ORC-greeting-001: No crucible-binding block follows

errors.violation: Oracle has two crucible-binding fences before the next `## ` heading; exactly one is required.
errors.heading: ## ORC-greeting-001: Two crucible-binding blocks

errors.violation: Binding `kind` is `smoke`, which is not in the enum unit|property|contract|integration.
errors.heading: ## ORC-greeting-001: Binding kind is not in the enum

errors.violation: Binding omits the required `requirement` field; a binding with zero requirements is forbidden.
errors.heading: ## ORC-greeting-001: Binding omits the requirement field
errors.locator: ## ORC-greeting-001: Binding omits the requirement field
